# CycloneDX 1.6 JSON Schema

The release SBOM verifier uses these upstream CycloneDX schema documents as
offline validation inputs. The upstream license is included in LICENSE.
The JSON was re-encoded with ASCII escapes and a final newline.

- `bom-1.6.schema.json` from https://cyclonedx.org/schema/bom-1.6.schema.json (upstream SHA-256 `1ebcb88a2c845ecb6ff7bee7aeabdff9422cb0347f3d6875b241bd444b7e098f`).
- `jsf-0.82.schema.json` from https://cyclonedx.org/schema/jsf-0.82.schema.json (upstream SHA-256 `2faf5eb3651f2ae5f46091a131770d8d847bbd121139d19c85fc7051bfa58c46`).
- `spdx.schema.json` from https://cyclonedx.org/schema/spdx.schema.json (upstream SHA-256 `33863a360fc4d348e183d89c1ca7aa0877f481e7eb55be2d4102a30386188a10`).
